item.title: Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events
item.description:
Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events

Eventbrite introduced an autocomplete capability for its Search events function.

🔍 Overview

  • New autocomplete appears in the Search events workflow.

🛠️ Features

  • Search events
  • autocomplete
  • Find my tickets
  • Sign in
  • Find Events
  • Create Events
  • Solutions
  • Event Ticketing
  • Event Marketing Platform
  • Eventbrite Ads
  • Payments

📂 Supported Industries

  • Music
  • Food & Beverage
  • Performing Arts
  • Charity & Causes
  • Retail

🎫 Event Types

  • Concerts
  • Classes & Workshops
  • Festivals & Fairs
  • Conferences
  • Corporate Events
  • Online Events

🚀 Release

  • Announced at the Oct 8 – MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup, an online event hosted by Voxel51.
  • The meetup took place on Thursday, October 8, 9 AM – 11 AM PDT.
  • Sales ended for the event on Thu, Oct 8, 9 AM PDT.

#Eventbrite #AI #Search #Autocomplete #Events

Source: Oct 8 - MCP/Agents/Skills Meetup

item.title: New Comprehensive Frankfurt Event Calendar Launched
item.description:
New Comprehensive Frankfurt Event Calendar Launched

A new calendar serves as a comprehensive guide to Frankfurt’s diversified event landscape.

📅 Overview

  • “Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Frankfurt events, which includes everything from thrilling concerts to fascinating cultural festivals.”
  • “This calendar is your comprehensive guide to Frankfurt’s diversified event landscape.”
  • “A new discovery awaits you every day, so come and experience the dynamism and creativity of this unique city.”

🎭 Types of Events

  • Thrilling concerts
  • Fascinating cultural festivals
  • Lively art scene
  • Major sporting events
  • Traditional markets
  • Innovative theatre productions
  • Eclectic music events catering to every taste

🗺️ Planning Made Easy

  • “Plan your visit with ease and find events that match your interests perfectly.”
  • Experience the city in all of its facets, from the lively art scene to major sporting events.
  • Discover local festivals that get Frankfurt’s heart beating.

Experience Frankfurt through this calendar and enjoy a dynamic, creative city every day.

#Frankfurt #Events #Travel #Culture

Source: Calendar of Events
